feature-engineering.name: Feature engineering
feature-engineering.description: Transform model inputs while preventing leakage and preserving training consistency.

supervised-learning.name: Classification and regression pipelines
supervised-learning.description: Train classification and regression models with reproducible preprocessing, suitable objectives, and validation splits that prevent leakage.

unsupervised-learning.name: Clustering and dimensionality reduction
unsupervised-learning.description: Fit clustering or dimensionality-reduction pipelines, scale features appropriately, and assess stability and usefulness of the resulting groups or representations.

model-evaluation.name: Leakage-safe model validation
model-evaluation.description: Choose grouped, temporal, or held-out splits that reflect deployment conditions, and compare metrics against baselines and error costs.

hyperparameter-tuning.name: Hyperparameter tuning
hyperparameter-tuning.description: Compare model configurations through reproducible searches and independent validation.

deep-learning.name: Neural network training
deep-learning.description: Implement training loops with explicit losses, optimizers, checkpointing, and validation, and diagnose overfitting or unstable optimization.

nlp.name: Text classification and entity extraction
nlp.description: Build text preprocessing and modeling pipelines for classification or entity extraction, and evaluate errors on representative labeled text.

computer-vision.name: Image classification and object detection
computer-vision.description: Prepare labeled image datasets, apply augmentation without contaminating validation data, and evaluate classification or detection errors.

recommendation-systems.name: Recommendation systems
recommendation-systems.description: Rank relevant items using user behavior, item features, and offline and online evaluation.

model-explainability.name: Model explainability
model-explainability.description: Explain model behavior with interpretable methods and documented limitations.

responsible-ml.name: Model fairness and subgroup evaluation
responsible-ml.description: Compare model errors and calibration across relevant subgroups, document dataset limitations, and test the effect of mitigation choices.

ml-pipelines.name: Machine learning pipelines
ml-pipelines.description: Automate validated data preparation, training, evaluation, and promotion stages.

model-serving.name: Model serving
model-serving.description: Deploy inference interfaces with versioning, batching, latency controls, and failure handling.

model-monitoring.name: Model monitoring
model-monitoring.description: Track prediction quality, feature drift, data changes, and inference performance.

ml-experiment-tracking.name: Machine learning experiment tracking
ml-experiment-tracking.description: Record datasets, parameters, metrics, artifacts, and code versions for reproducible training.

ml-system-design.name: Training-serving consistency and feature freshness
ml-system-design.description: Align feature transformations between training and inference, version model and feature dependencies, and handle stale or missing online features.
